patterns.name: Destination receipt
patterns.anatomy: Selected journey and audience stay visible beside capture; Only me is an explicit value
patterns.states: unknown journey, stale membership, offline
patterns.rule: No location inference; selecting a destination does not contribute
patterns.fieldwork: Destination picker shows journey/day, date certainty and owner context. A consequential move gets a separate review; ordinary navigation selects immediately.

patterns.name: Capture controls
patterns.anatomy: Labelled Photo, Video, Voice, Text controls with a steady record/stop state
patterns.states: denied permission, interrupted, local saving, failed
patterns.rule: Capture confirmation follows durable local saving only
patterns.fieldwork: The shutter acknowledges the tap immediately; ‘Saved on this device’ appears only after durable local persistence. Retain a small inspectable capture strip.

patterns.name: Transfer receipt
patterns.anatomy: Separate Local file, Private backup, Contribution, Publication eligibility rows
patterns.states: queued, transferring, finalizing, unknown, failed, missing file
patterns.rule: A transfer bar never stands in for publication or backup verification
patterns.fieldwork: An expandable receipt shows four independent states instead of one reassuring checkmark. Retry stays attached to the failed operation.

patterns.name: Import inspection
patterns.anatomy: Selected file row plus metadata correction and explicit batch approval
patterns.states: unsupported, missing, duplicate, uncertain date/location
patterns.rule: Selection is not approval and not upload
patterns.fieldwork: Import becomes an inspection tray: choose, inspect crop/metadata, correct destination, then explicitly confirm selected candidates.

patterns.name: Scope review
patterns.anatomy: Equal scope choices plus Current/Proposed comparison
patterns.states: mixed sources, stale permissions, narrowed grant, pending
patterns.rule: Original export remains a separate task
patterns.fieldwork: Show a compact consequence summary under each scope choice; keep explicit review and separate export controls.

patterns.name: Original export grant
patterns.anatomy: Exact recipient, files and expiry with explicit approve/decline
patterns.states: expired, departed recipient, revoked, fresh identity required
patterns.rule: Membership and source reuse confer no export grant
patterns.fieldwork: Use an exact recipient/source/action receipt with explicit original-export rights and expiry where supported.

patterns.name: Evidence note
patterns.anatomy: Source title, provenance, date, scope and return-to-passage
patterns.states: review-only, approved, withdrawn, no transcript
patterns.rule: Public projection contains approved accessible data only
patterns.fieldwork: A margin line joins the exact cited sentence to its evidence note. The note carries author, date and source type; returning restores the sentence. This association is not a truth/verification indicator.

patterns.name: Transcript correction
patterns.anatomy: Original wording and proposed correction together with source offset
patterns.states: unsupported language, processing, stale edit, offline
patterns.rule: Correction does not authorize publication or grant reuse
patterns.fieldwork: Show correction beside the original transcript segment and preserve its time anchor. Make changed words easy to inspect.

patterns.name: Stage and branch
patterns.anatomy: Named stage sequence and participant-specific branch labels
patterns.states: no GPS/rest day, gap, estimated, disputed
patterns.rule: Keep chapter, stage and source identities distinct
patterns.fieldwork: One selected day coordinates the picker, stage index and already-open map sheet. The stage index denotes chronology, not route continuity. Map follow is explicit and stops on manual panning.

patterns.name: Practical observation
patterns.anatomy: Amount, currency, unit, party size and observation date beside evidence
patterns.states: estimated, conflicting, unknown, redacted
patterns.rule: A dated report is not current travel advice
patterns.fieldwork: Present practical observations as dated reports with attached evidence and uncertainty, not confident evergreen advice.

patterns.name: Editor and insertion
patterns.anatomy: Readable chapter with source insertion tray and visible edit status
patterns.states: long text, source withdrawn, offline retained
patterns.rule: No drag-only ordering; source access checked again
patterns.fieldwork: Insert at a visible gap between story blocks; preview permitted media there before committing. Reorder keeps a clear drop marker and Move controls.

patterns.name: Conflict comparison
patterns.anatomy: Current accepted text and retained candidate, with scoped resolution
patterns.states: stale again, rights lost, offline, evidence withdrawn
patterns.rule: No silent overwrite or automatic retry against a changed base
patterns.fieldwork: A calm comparison labels Your version, Current version and affected fields, with a reliable return to the editing context.

patterns.name: Publication blocker
patterns.anatomy: Affected source, exact dependent uses and authorized repair task
patterns.states: owner, coauthor, publisher-only, inaccessible evidence
patterns.rule: Repair controls are capability filtered; publisher authority is distinct
patterns.fieldwork: Each blocker opens the exact affected source or permission task; return preserves position and asks for a fresh preview when required.

patterns.name: Exact candidate preview
patterns.anatomy: Candidate identity across Story, Explore, Learn and source inspection
patterns.states: building, ready, invalidated, failed, current publication
patterns.rule: Approval binds the reviewed candidate and current rights
patterns.fieldwork: Make the exact candidate recognisable with a stable review label and visible changes since review.

patterns.name: Visibility approval
patterns.anatomy: Audience explanation and explicit designated-publisher approval
patterns.states: unlisted, public, draft changed, permission changed
patterns.rule: Catalog listing is a separate submission
patterns.fieldwork: Keep visibility approval distinct from listing; make the chosen audience readable in a plain summary.

patterns.name: Listing receipt
patterns.anatomy: Submission/status shown beside independent approved-publication state
patterns.states: not submitted, pending, listed, rejected, removed
patterns.rule: Listing rejection does not itself unpublish
patterns.fieldwork: Place listing status next to, but separate from, publication status; provide the relevant next step.

patterns.name: Highlight selection
patterns.anatomy: Approved attributed sources, personal caption and full-journey disclosure
patterns.states: none eligible, withdrawn, generation failure
patterns.rule: Recipient is read-only; external copies cannot be recalled
patterns.fieldwork: A small contact sheet shows eligible approved photographs and attribution; preview the recipient experience before sharing.

patterns.name: Grounded answer
patterns.anatomy: Buffered answer, dated citations and a return to the exact source
patterns.states: sign-in required, abstention, quota, invalidation, provider failure
patterns.rule: No streaming internal reasoning or hidden-source citation
patterns.fieldwork: Readable buffered answer, dated evidence seam and exact return anchor. Abstention gets a useful next question or source path.

patterns.name: Lifecycle impact
patterns.anatomy: Exact object, rights impact and honest operation receipt
patterns.states: fresh identity, stale impact, unknown, cleanup pending
patterns.rule: No success until known; source owner retains safe access after departure
patterns.fieldwork: State exact impact, changed/stale impact and honest unknown outcomes in a stable dialog/receipt.

patterns.name: Invitation acceptance
patterns.anatomy: Named inviter/journey only when permitted and explicit Accept
patterns.states: signed out, wrong account, expired, already member
patterns.rule: Authentication preserves intent but never accepts automatically
patterns.fieldwork: Preserve invitation intent through authentication, then show a clear invitation receipt and explicit Accept.

patterns.name: Saved research
patterns.anatomy: Private note attached to a currently accessible reference
patterns.states: empty, unavailable reference, save failure
patterns.rule: Keep typed note on failure; scrub denied preview data
patterns.fieldwork: Save a private note beside its accessible citation; preserve the note on failure and restore the reading position.

patterns.name: Safe unavailable
patterns.anatomy: Generic public recovery and neutral source-owner destination
patterns.states: withdrawn share/source, denied, missing, departed owner
patterns.rule: Do not leak private title, location, cover or member list
patterns.fieldwork: Use a neutral unavailable state with a safe route back; retain only information the viewer may still see.

signatures.name: A day picker attached to the index
signatures.value: Find the correct day/source with fewer inspections.
signatures.proposal: Continue the chronological day index into a compact picker, with ordinal flags, place/date cues and explicit recording status. Ordinary settings remain simple selects; consequential destination moves get a separate review.
signatures.web: Open from the actual trigger edge. Selecting a day updates the same day identity used by the visible sheet; focus alone never commits. No new map initialisation.
signatures.native: Use the same day-index anatomy inside a full-size search sheet, not a small floating desktop popover.
signatures.test: Compare names-only, rich rows and index-connected rows for wrong-day choice and speed. Ask what the connecting line means; reject it if mistaken for a recorded route.

signatures.name: A claim visibly joined to its evidence
signatures.value: Understand why a statement is present without losing the story.
signatures.proposal: A quiet margin line joins only the cited sentence to its open note. Return to sentence restores focus; the line denotes association, never proof or certainty.
signatures.web: Inline short evidence or a bounded side inspection; maintain source anchor.
signatures.native: Inline for short notes; long source sheets carry the quoted claim in their heading. The return action restores the exact claim.
signatures.test: Ask readers to verify a dated claim and resume reading. Observe lost position and mistaken certainty.

signatures.name: One current day
signatures.value: Stay oriented across story, photographs and map.
signatures.proposal: Reuse one selected-day identity. Map stays uninitialised until requested; Follow story is opt-in and stops when the user pans.
signatures.web: Day marker and content update; camera movement is a separate deliberate action or explicitly enabled follow.
signatures.native: Persistent day heading in the map sheet; expand/collapse buttons accompany drag.
signatures.test: Navigate, pan, inspect a source, rotate and return with keyboard/large text. Reject any automatic movement that overrides intent.

signatures.name: Tools beside the selection
signatures.value: Act on sources without a dashboard toolbar occupying the screen.
signatures.proposal: A stable action area exposes selected count and per-action eligibility when capabilities differ. Ownership is shown as context, while independently supplied permissions determine available actions.
signatures.web: Keep focus in the row; optional shortcut to the toolbar. No bouncing floating dock.
signatures.native: A safe-area action shelf that does not cover the last row or keyboard.
signatures.test: Select mixed-owner/mixed-eligibility items, filter and return. Inspect the exact subset before a consequential action; recheck capability. No silent partial success.

signatures.name: An editorial crop opening into the full photograph
signatures.value: Give photographs presence while preserving the journey’s context.
signatures.proposal: Preserve Fieldwork’s actual asymmetric frame and day/moment anchor while revealing the uncropped image, caption and attribution. Return to the same place in the story. In-story inspection is separate from K17 highlight sharing.
signatures.web: Evaluate PhotoSwipe for the existing viewer requirement; load only authorised derivatives on explicit inspection.
signatures.native: Native image viewer with equivalent interactions; no reuse of DOM components.
signatures.test: Zoom/pan, change image, rotate and close on low-memory hardware; confirm caption legibility and return position.

sources.name: Radix Dropdown Menu
sources.decision: Keep the existing semantic foundation; adapt trigger-aware motion and composition.
sources.finding: The documented primitive provides menu keyboard/focus contracts and exposes the transform origin. This is an action menu, not a universal rich picker.
sources.fit: High for selected web stack; no native DOM reuse.

sources.name: coss ui
sources.decision: Adapt rich choice anatomy and size/clear/group variants.
sources.finding: Official demos/source expose small/large inputs, groups and chips. Repository license is MIT despite GitHub’s NOASSERTION classification.
sources.activity: Repo pushed 2026-11-04; point-in-time activity, not a sustainability guarantee.
sources.fit: Base UI underlies its components. Borrow anatomy; don't add a second primitive foundation just for these visuals.

sources.name: React Aria
sources.decision: Use as an accessibility and interaction reference.
sources.finding: Collection APIs distinguish filtering from selection; drag/drop documentation includes keyboard and screen-reader paths.
sources.fit: Strong reference for complex collections; direct adoption adds another DOM interaction stack.

sources.name: Motion Primitives
sources.decision: Adapt selection-surface continuity and contextual expansion; do not wholesale copy demos.
sources.finding: Expandable toolbar source contains hardcoded demo items and react-use-measure/Motion dependencies. Animated background uses shared layoutId; semantics and reduced-motion handling remain application responsibilities.
sources.fit: React web inspiration. Default demo dimensions/positioning do not fit native targets or Kairn’s selection rules.

sources.name: easeful
sources.decision: Adopt the small CSS motion vocabulary as a design principle; evaluate own tiny styles before a package.
sources.finding: Inspected origin, tokens and reduced-motion source. It reads host state attributes and retains fade under reduced motion. Runtime CSS adds no JavaScript; focus/ARIA remain with the host primitive.
sources.activity: Registry latest 0.1.3; repo pushed 2026-08-23. Small early project, so inspiration before dependency.
sources.fit: High conceptual fit for current web CSS approach. Validate lifecycle and CSS layer behaviour; not a native solution.

sources.name: PhotoSwipe
sources.decision: Strong web viewer candidate when the gallery is implemented; adapt its continuity, not every default.
sources.finding: Supports thumbnail-based opening, configurable transitions and reduced-motion behaviour; looping can be disabled.
sources.fit: Web-only viewer; authorisation, captions, loading policy and native viewer remain Kairn responsibilities.

sources.name: Motion
sources.decision: Reserve for a demonstrated shared-layout/gesture need, not every button.
sources.finding: MotionConfig and useReducedMotion support reduced motion. The API does not choose appropriate product semantics or automatically make camera movement accessible.
sources.fit: React web. Current app CSS motion stays selected until a concrete need justifies a dependency.

sources.name: Animate UI
sources.decision: Visual inspiration only for this shortlist.
sources.finding: Current license is MIT plus a Commons Clause condition restricting component redistribution, not plain MIT. Avoid importing a broad animated layer for small effects.
sources.fit: React web and primitive wrappers; license and animation/API costs need explicit evaluation for reusable library distribution.

sources.name: Vaul
sources.decision: Study sheet ergonomics; do not introduce as a new dependency.
sources.finding: Current repository README explicitly says it is unmaintained.
sources.activity: Repo pushed 2025-10-03; maintainer notice outweighs popularity.
sources.fit: Web drawer; native sheet still needs a separate implementation.

baselineRequirements.name: Honest receipts — a baseline requirement
baselineRequirements.value: Replace vague reassurance with an understandable account of what is actually saved or shared.
baselineRequirements.proposal: Use the disclosure anatomy for separate local-file, private-backup, contribution and publication states. This is required clarity, not a signature animation experiment.
baselineRequirements.web: Attached to source row and recoverable inline.
baselineRequirements.native: Tap to inspect the receipt; failure and retry remain reachable offline.
baselineRequirements.test: Interrupt a transfer and ask what is local, backed up, contributed and published. A user must not infer one state from another.

boundaries: Fieldwork 1.0 selected on 6 November 2026. Design artifacts are authoritative for visuals; application code and dependency integration remain unchanged.
Share identity, semantics and tokens across web/native; do not share DOM components.
Selected stack remains web shadcn/Radix/Tailwind, native Expo/React Native/Unistyles and current Mapbox integrations.
Source scope, original export, membership, backup and publication remain separate.
Keep 36px compact desktop and at least 48px native touch targets; content can grow with text.
Maps open on explicit request; never auto-load a map through story scrolling or preview a fabricated connecting route.
Everything meaningful works without hover, drag, haptics or spatial animation.
All sample journey data in visual sketches is fictional; this is not a functioning app or proof of accessibility/performance.
rejectedPatterns: Magnetic buttons, cursor followers, glowing borders and text scrambling: repeated distraction without task value.
Radial menus, gesture-only navigation and long-press-only actions: poor discoverability and cross-platform consistency.
Elastic menus and bouncing sheets over a map: competing motion and precision cost.
Hold-to-confirm as the only safety mechanism: inaccessible substitution for clear consequences and explicit confirmation.
Auto-advancing galleries, cinematic map flights and story scroll hijacking: loss of user control.
One universal animated wrapper or importing all libraries: hidden maintenance and rendering cost.

accepted: Corrected the truncated Fieldwork SHA-256 in the research record.
Separated creative prototype order from domain-clarity priorities.
Mapped in-story photo inspection independently of K17 recipient highlights.
Linked day selection across the picker and map-sheet sketch.
Added capability summaries to mixed-owner selection without deriving permissions from ownership.
Added all nine dimension-verified control specimens; five are additional instances, four already appear among the 32 masters.
Added a shared sentence/evidence margin and explicit return-to-sentence action.
modifiedOrRejected: Day-index continuity is chronological only. Rejected encoding GPS continuity in that connecting line; gaps remain explicitly labelled.
Kept actual Fieldwork photo geometry (24/8/24/8 in the existing sketch), not the review’s unverified 16/16/4/16 values.
Review’s claim that narrow controls stayed 36px was not supported by the existing media rule; verify computed sizes rather than adding duplicate CSS.
No outer body/main padding added: the inline renderer owns its gutter. Kept the open editorial layout rather than adding a card grid.
The original selection action was inspection only; a plain count did not itself grant rights. Accepted richer eligibility information as a product improvement, not proof of an authorisation bug.
